name: Dr Gore's CORPSE Campaign
source:
As Dr. Gore, you’ve obliterated the city of Vilemore and plunged it into post-apocalyptic chaos. But the real problem? Your companion has gone missing, head first. 

Now you must search for his body and carry his sentient, talking head wherever you go – while a bizarre angel keeps appearing, just to complicate things further.

[From [url=https://crustycatman.itch.io/dr-gores-corpse-campaign]Itch.io[/url]]
